ctx.x: Dave Wilburn -- I forgot -- on banjo -- Dave Wilburn. And Dave was with the Cotton Pickers for 30 years. I imagine that's the only orchestra he ever played with -- McKinney's Cotton Pickers. So they originated in Springfield, Ohio. But before even we organized our group there were groups like Willis and Warmack out of Dayton, Ohio; Brown from Columbus, Ohio; Don O'Niel from Springfield. These were four-piece, saxophone, piano -- no bass -- banjo and drums. Didn't use a bass then at all.
